title: oven-roasted-malaysian-lamb-biryani
description: A flavorful, malaysian-inspired biryani dish made with tender lamb, fragrant spices, and fluffy basmati rice.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together lamb, cumin, coriander, turmeric, red chili powder, and salt. Set aside.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear the lamb until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the lamb and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté the onions until lightly browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the coconut milk, kaffir lime leaves, and browned lamb. Stir to combine and bring to a simmer.
Add the basmati rice to the pot and stir to coat the rice in the spice mixture. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the cooked lamb and chopped cilantro.
Transfer the biryani to a serving platter and garnish with additional cilantro, if desired.
Serve hot, with yogurt or raita on the side, if desired.
